leftOut: The interior and exterior departments have distinct responsibilities, but they do not compete as teams in an official standings table.
Charter gratuities are shared among eligible crew members, and the amount can be scored as money rather than as a competitive victory.
The captain and department heads have different levels of authority, and performance assessments can lead to staffing changes.
Charter guests rotate throughout the season and are temporary participants rather than permanent members of the crew cast.
The yacht's destination, weather, mechanical condition, guest itineraries, and excursions create situational challenges that do not follow a fixed competitive format.
The season may include a special departure, an unexpected staffing change, or an unusual guest incident that does not fit a recurring segment or a formal twist.
The latest season is still airing, so its complete episode count and any later structural changes cannot yet be established with certainty.

blocks.tagline: Luxury yacht service, demanding guests, and crew drama
blocks.premise: A captain and a professional yacht crew live and work aboard a luxury yacht while hosting wealthy charter guests with demanding preferences. Each episode follows the crew as they deliver hospitality, manage yacht operations, handle problems, and navigate workplace relationships. The season ends when the charter season concludes, rather than with a competitive winner.

phases.name: Crew Settles In
phases.summary: The captain and crew establish their working relationships, settle into their roles, and prepare to meet the demands of the charter season.

phases.name: Charter Season
phases.summary: The crew repeatedly prepares for guest arrivals, delivers hospitality and yacht operations, handles requests and problems, shares gratuities, and navigates professional and personal tensions.

phases.name: Closing Charter
phases.summary: The crew completes its final scheduled charter and wraps up the season's professional and personal storylines.

finale.summary: The season concludes with the final charter, its gratuity discussion, and reflections on the crew's work and relationships, without crowning a competitive winner.

segments.name: Charter Preparation
segments.summary: The crew reviews guest preferences, prepares cabins and service areas, organizes supplies, and coordinates the yacht's readiness before guests arrive.

segments.name: Guest Arrival
segments.summary: The crew welcomes charter guests aboard, learns their expectations, and begins the service period under scrutiny.

segments.name: Charter
segments.summary: The interior and exterior crew provide hospitality, meals, activities, excursions, and yacht operations while adapting to guest requests, changing conditions, and service problems.

segments.name: Tip Meeting
segments.summary: After a charter, the captain reveals the guests' gratuity and the crew discusses the amount received and the service provided.

segments.name: Crew Night Out
segments.summary: Crew members socialize away from their duties, allowing friendships, flirtations, rivalries, and disagreements to develop or intensify.

segments.name: Captain's Debrief
segments.summary: The captain and crew discuss work quality, leadership, mistakes, guest satisfaction, and expectations for future charters.
